note: Approved with one required deviation: drop the colored left-border bar on split rows (present in this render) — it reintroduces the 'side-tab' AI-tell pattern the redesign is meant to retire. Use the channel-color LED dot only.

inventory.ground: matte black (#0a0a0a), true near-black, not the old soft charcoal-green
inventory.panel: hairline 1px border (#242424 'bezel'), 12px corner radius, no shadow/elevation — flat instrument-panel language, not card elevation
inventory.divider: 1px hairline border between stacked rows inside one panel, not gaps between separate cards
inventory.type_ramp: labels: 9-10px uppercase, letter-spacing 1-1.5px, muted gray (#888); values: 15-22px monospace/tabular-nums, bold, full ink (#f5f6f4); body copy stays a warm humanist sans, never mono
inventory.channel_color: small circular LED dot (6-8px), never a border bar; category color is otherwise reserved for the dot and for filled/active states only
inventory.state_language: amber (#e8b23d) reserved for genuine signal/warning states, shown as a bounded pill with an LED dot, never a floating alarm badge or an unbounded list
inventory.primary_action: the readiness strip's active segments fill solid in the channel color; inactive segments stay bezel-outlined only
